from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Summoning the Dandelin Spheres", [
            "Place a small sphere above the intersecting plane.",
            "Place a larger sphere below the plane.",
            "Both spheres touch the cone along horizontal circles.",

            "These points of contact are called the Dandelin foci."
        ])

        # Visual Elements Construction (Internal Coordinates)
        # Cone (Cross-section V-shape)
        cone_v = np.array([0, 2.5, 0])
        cone_l = np.array([-2.0, -3, 0])
        cone_r = np.array([2.0, -3, 0])
        cone = VGroup(Line(cone_v, cone_l), Line(cone_v, cone_r)).set_color(WHITE)

        # Plane (Tilted Line)
        plane_line = Line(np.array([-2.2, 0.4, 0]), np.array([2.2, -0.6, 0])).set_color("#1E90FF")

        # Spheres (represented as circles in cross-section)
        sphere_s = Circle(radius=0.7, color="#D3D3D3", fill_opacity=0.4).move_to([0, 1.4, 0])
        sphere_l = Circle(radius=1.3, color="#D3D3D3", fill_opacity=0.4).move_to([0, -1.2, 0])

        contact_l = DashedLine(np.array([-1.0, -1.2, 0]), np.array([1.0, -1.2, 0]), color=WHITE)

        # Foci (Points on the plane tangent to spheres)
        # Positions adjusted for visual tangency in the 2D schematic
        f1_pos = np.array([0.3, 0.05, 0])
        f2_pos = np.array([-0.4, -0.01, 0])
        f1 = Dot(f1_pos, color="#FF0000")
        f2 = Dot(f2_pos, color="#FF0000")
        
        f1_label = Text("F1", font_size=24, color="#FF0000")
        f2_label = Text("F2", font_size=24, color="#FF0000")

        # Group construction for grid placement
        construction = VGroup(cone, plane_line, sphere_s, sphere_l, contact_s, contact_l, f1, f2)
        self.place_in_area(construction, "B1", "F6", scale_factor=0.85)

        # Labels relative to dots after construction is positioned
        f1_label.next_to(f1, RIGHT, buff=0.15)
        f2_label.next_to(f2, LEFT, buff=0.15)

        # Start animation sequence
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#D3D3D3"))
        self.play(Create(cone), Create(plane_line))
        self.play(FadeIn(sphere_s))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#D3D3D3"))
        self.play(FadeIn(sphere_l))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.play(Create(contact_s), Create(contact_l))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
        self.play(FadeIn(f1), FadeIn(f2))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
